  • Method Details

    • validateCode

      @Nullable Boolean validateCode(@Nonnull String valueSetUrl, @Nonnull Coding coding)
      Validates that a coded value is in a value set. Abstracts the FHIR ValueSet/$validate-code operation.

      A coding that lacks a system or a code is not a member of any value set. The membership is unknown where the value set cannot be resolved, or the terminology server rejects the request.

      Parameters:
      valueSetUrl - the URL of the value set to validate against
      coding - the coding to test
      Returns:
      true if the coding is a member of the value set, false if it is not, or null if the membership is unknown

    • validateCodeInferringSystem

      @Nullable Boolean validateCodeInferringSystem(@Nonnull String valueSetUrl, @Nonnull String code)
      Validates that a code without a system is in a value set, inferring the system from the value set. Abstracts the FHIR ValueSet/$validate-code operation with the inferSystem parameter.

      The membership is unknown where the value set cannot be resolved, or the terminology server rejects the request, for example because it does not support system inference.

      Parameters:
      valueSetUrl - the URL of the value set to validate against
      code - the code to test
      Returns:
      true if the code is a member of the value set, false if it is not, or null if the membership is unknown

    • translate

      @Nonnull List<TerminologyService.Translation> translate(@Nonnull Coding coding, @Nonnull String conceptMapUrl, boolean reverse, @Nullable String target)
      Translates a code from one value set to another, based on the existing concept map. Abstracts the FHIR ConceptMap/$translate operation.
      Parameters:
      coding - the code to translate.
      conceptMapUrl - the url of the concept map to use for translation.
      reverse - if this is true, then the operation should return all the codes that might be mapped to this code.
      target - identifies the value set in which a translation is sought. If null all known translations are returned.
      Returns:
      the list of translations.

    • subsumes

      @Nonnull ConceptSubsumptionOutcome subsumes(@Nonnull Coding codingA, @Nonnull Coding codingB)
      Tests the subsumption relationship between two codings given the semantics of subsumption in the underlying code system. Abstracts the CodeSystem/$subsumes operation.
      Parameters:
      codingA - the left code to be tested.
      codingB - the right code to be tested.
      Returns:
      ConceptSubsumptionOutcome representing the relation between codingA (left code) and codingB (right code).

    • lookup

      @Nonnull List<TerminologyService.PropertyOrDesignation> lookup(@Nonnull Coding coding, @Nullable String propertyCode, @Nullable String acceptLanguage)
      Gets additional details about the concept, including designations and properties. Abstracts the CodeSystem/$lookup operation.
      Parameters:
      coding - the coding to lookup.
      propertyCode - the code of the propertyCode to lookup. If not null only the properties with matching codes are returned.
      acceptLanguage - the preferred language for display and other localised properties.
      Returns:
      the list of properties and/or designations.

    • expand

      @Nonnull Optional<ValueSetExpansion> expand(@Nonnull String url, @Nullable String version, int maxMembers)
      Expands a value set identified by canonical URL to its membership.
      Parameters:
      url - the canonical URL of the value set, without a version suffix
      version - the value set version to expand, or null for the source's default
      maxMembers - the largest membership the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the expansion, or empty if the canonical URL cannot be resolved
      Throws:
      ValueSetExpansionException - if the value set resolves but its membership cannot be determined, including when the terminology source cannot be reached
      ValueSetLookupException - if, in SERVER mode, the terminology server answers the first page of the expansion with a failure status other than 404, or cannot be reached for it, so that it is unknown whether the URL is a value set
      ExpansionLimitExceededException - if the membership exceeds maxMembers

    • expand

      @Nonnull ValueSetExpansion expand(@Nonnull ValueSet valueSet, int maxMembers)
      Expands a value set supplied as a resource. Where the resource carries an expansion, that expansion is the membership; otherwise its compose is expanded.
      Parameters:
      valueSet - the value set resource
      maxMembers - the largest membership the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the expansion
      Throws:
      ValueSetExpansionException - if the membership cannot be determined
      ExpansionLimitExceededException - if the membership exceeds maxMembers

    • readConceptMap

      @Nonnull Optional<ConceptMapContent> readConceptMap(@Nonnull String url, @Nullable String version, int maxMappings)
      Reads a concept map by canonical URL and converts it to the rows of a concept map relation.
      Parameters:
      url - the canonical URL of the concept map, without a version suffix
      version - the version to read, or null for the latest the source holds
      maxMappings - the largest number of rows the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the content, or empty where the source holds no concept map at the URL
      Throws:
      ConceptMapContentException - if the map resolves but its content cannot be represented, or the source fails
      ConceptMapLimitExceededException - if the map has more than maxMappings rows
      ConceptMapVersionException - if the version to use cannot be determined
      ConceptMapLookupException - if, in SERVER mode, the ConceptMap search fails with a server error other than 501 or the server cannot be reached
